India's growing role in global energy infrastructure and refining

Reports highlight India's potential to become a global producer of clean energy infrastructure, with a clean tech CEO praising the India-EU Free Trade Agreement. Concurrently, India is strengthening its position as a global refining power, enhancing its energy security and fuel export capabilities. These developments underscore India's expanding influence in the international energy sector.
